reason: The report controls for collab_index_2023, a post-treatment 2023 variable that remote share affects (coefficient 0.6 on remote_share) and that also drives patents; this collider/mediator control creates the -2.7 estimate. With only pre-period controls (with or without extra covariates) the effect is about -0.28 (SE 0.24), which is not significant, so 'negative effect' is unsupported.
